name: @ncfritz/harpocrates-signer
description: Harpocrates's signer (Python): holds the CA's private keys and signs; its Turbo tasks call uv
author: Neil Fritz (ncfritz@ncfritz.net)

scripts.openapi: uv run --locked python -m harpocrates_signer openapi openapi
scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff check && uv run --locked ruff format --check
scripts.lintfix: uv run --locked ruff check --fix && uv run --locked ruff format
scripts.check:openapi: rm -rf .openapi-check && uv run --locked python -m harpocrates_signer openapi .openapi-check > /dev/null && diff -r openapi .openapi-check && rm -rf .openapi-check
scripts.start: uv run --locked --env-file dev.env python -m harpocrates_signer serve
scripts.dev: uv run --locked --env-file dev.env python -m harpocrates_signer serve --reload
